name: professional-tax
description: State professional tax (tax on professions, trades, callings and employments) on a monthly salary, by state. Slabs are as each state levies them: monthly for most states, annual for Madhya Pradesh, half-yearly for Tamil Nadu. A slab's 'upto' is inclusive and 'below' is exclusive; 'amount' is the deduction for the payslip month, 'month_overrides' replaces it in a given month (2 = February), and 'deduct_in_months' limits deduction to those months of the year.

sources.title: The Maharashtra State Tax on Professions, Trades, Callings and Employments Act, 1975 (text as published by the Maharashtra GST Department)
sources.notes: Schedule I (see section 3), entry 1, as substituted by Maharashtra Act 19 of 2023: men pay nil up to ₹7,500, ₹175 a month from ₹7,501 to ₹10,000, and ₹2,500 a year above ₹10,000 (₹200 a month, ₹300 in February); women pay nil up to ₹25,000 and the same ₹2,500 a year above it.

sources.title: Commercial Taxes Department, Government of Karnataka: Profession Tax FAQ
sources.notes: Salaried individuals with monthly gross income below ₹25,000 are exempt with effect from 01-04-2023; tax applies at ₹25,000 and above. The department's portal notice states February PT is ₹300 per employee instead of ₹200, per Notification No. DPAL 08 SHASANA 2025, Bengaluru, dated 15-04-2025.

sources.title: Greater Chennai Corporation press release PR No. 356 dated 05-08-2026: deduction and remittance of profession tax by employers
sources.notes: Half-yearly slabs under section 117-C of the Tamil Nadu Urban Local Bodies Act, 1998 and rule 277 of the Tamil Nadu Urban Local Bodies Rules, 2023, as revised from the second half-year of 2024-25: nil up to ₹21,000, then ₹180 / ₹425 / ₹930 / ₹1,025 / ₹1,250. Deducted from the August and January salary and remitted by 30 September / 31 January.

sources.title: Commercial Taxes Department, Government of Telangana: PT Schedule (First Schedule, Telangana Tax on Professions, Trades, Callings and Employments Act, 1987, as amended up to date)
sources.notes: Salary and wage earners: nil up to ₹15,000 a month, ₹150 a month from ₹15,001 to ₹20,000, ₹200 a month above ₹20,000.

sources.title: Gujarat Commercial Tax Department: Rate of Profession Tax under the Gujarat State Tax on Professions, Trades, Callings and Employments Act, 1976
sources.notes: Entry 1, salary and wage earners: nil up to ₹12,000 a month and ₹200 a month above ₹12,000, effective 01-04-2022 (the same for government and non-government employees).

sources.title: Madhya Pradesh Commercial Tax Department: Professional Tax schedule (registration checklist and rates)
sources.notes: Persons in employment, on annual salary or wages: nil up to ₹2,25,000; ₹1,500 a year (₹125 a month) above ₹2,25,000 up to ₹3,00,000; ₹2,000 a year (₹166 a month, ₹174 in the twelfth month) up to ₹4,00,000; ₹2,500 a year (₹208 a month, ₹212 in the twelfth month) above ₹4,00,000.

sources.title: West Bengal Finance Department notification No. 1407-F.T. dated 18-08-2026 (Kolkata Gazette), proposed new Schedule under section 3(2A)
sources.notes: Read, but not used: it is published for objections under section 3(3) and does not say when (or whether) it took effect. The schedule in force for 2026-27 could not be confirmed, so West Bengal is left out of the entries below.

entries.notes: Levied by the urban local body, not the state: these are the Greater Chennai Corporation slabs. Another corporation or municipality may differ.
Slabs are on annual salary; the monthly figures are the department's own. The twelfth month of the financial year is March.
